---
name: Experiment idea / 实验想法 / 実験の提案
about: Propose a new interactive learning experiment. No code required.
title: ''
---

English, 中文, 日本語 are all welcome. You do not need to write code.

### Question and audience / 问题与学习者 / 問いと対象
What should this experiment help someone understand?

### Interaction / 操作方式 / 操作
What can the learner change, move, or compare?

### Expected discovery / 预期发现 / 期待する発見
What would they predict, observe, or explain?

### Scientific basis / 科学依据 / 科学的根拠
Add references, formulas, assumptions, or limits if you have them.

### Contribution / 参与方式 / 協力できること
Would you like to help with an implementation, explanation, translation, or review? An idea alone is welcome.
